purpose: Test fixed-interface response condensation with nonlinear top-system storage before adding ET, drainage or memory.
questions: Does the exact nonlinear coupled root close the complete mass balance?
How does local dV/dz_p at the accepted state differ from the finite-window secant storage response?
What does predictor-derived u measure when dH_c/dq_b varies with predictor trajectory?
Does a locally reanchored affine response recover the exact nonlinear root under iteration?
gates_before_implementation: Derive the exact or high-precision independent root without using production u/q_u.
Derive the implicit response derivative analytically.
Keep physical storage tangent, finite-window secant, predictor inverse sensitivity and corrector derivative as separate reported quantities.
nonclaims: NH03 will not yet test ET, drainage or memory.
A local tangent match will not be treated as equality with integrated storage.
Solver convergence will not be treated as proof of the nonlinear equations.
